notes: Commodity baskets for the Food Origins explorer (spec §6.1). Each basket is the set of CN8 codes that HMRC's /Commodity endpoint lists under the given HS headings, including codes no longer in use, so the series is continuous across nomenclature changes. Verified against /Commodity on 23 Oct 2026 (docs/03-DATA-SOURCES.md, S01).

baskets.label: Tomatoes
baskets.definition: Tomatoes, fresh or chilled (HS 0702). Excludes processed tomatoes.

baskets.label: Bananas
baskets.definition: Bananas including plantains, fresh or dried (HS 0803).

baskets.label: Potatoes
baskets.definition: Potatoes, fresh or chilled, including seed potatoes (HS 0701). Excludes frozen and processed potatoes.

baskets.label: Wheat
baskets.definition: Wheat and meslin, including durum wheat and seed for sowing (HS 1001). Excludes flour.
